description: Build a contact sheet for a generated clip — N frames spread evenly over its runtime, tiled into ONE image — and show it. This is how a clip gets judged at all: MCP has no video content type, so without a sheet a clip is just a URL and a promise. It is also the fastest way to SEE camera drift: measured 2026-08-04, the wander in one clip was a PSNR number until frames sat side by side. The sheet is cached on the video row — a second call returns the same URL without re-rendering (pass force to redo it). Rendering downloads the clip and runs ffmpeg, so the first call takes a few seconds.

force.description: Re-render even if a sheet already exists

preview.description: Attach the sheet itself, downscaled to 512px, instead of only its URL. Default true — showing it is the whole point; pass false to get just the URL.

rows.description: Grid rows (default 3). cols x rows = number of frames

video_id.description: Generated video id (from lab_animate/lab_job_status) — positive integer as string

name: lab_contact_sheet
title: Contact Sheet
